title: Relay
summary: A voice-first People Operations portal that connects employee questions to grounded records, controlled actions, and verified workflow results.
landingDeck: Relay combines voice and text assistance with seven employee workflows across onboarding, tasks, learning, documents, equipment, payroll, benefits, and support.
landingHighlights: Uses structured function calling to retrieve authenticated records and prepare employee actions.
Applies role-based access, employee confirmation, idempotency, and append-only audit logs to consequential workflows.
Evaluates task success, voice usefulness, tool accuracy, safety, groundedness, latency, interruption handling, and recovery.
problem: Employee-service portals make people translate a human question into the right system, record, owner, form, and next action before they can get help.
approach: Relay combines a familiar employee workspace with a Deepgram-powered conversational guide. Typed records, semantic navigation, a small capability registry, explicit confirmation, idempotency, verification, and evidence logs keep conversation tied to visible product state.
output: A working React and Fastify product with text and voice interaction, five registered employee-owned workflows, current Relay-branded proof media, and a dedicated evaluation page built from retained run evidence.

methodology.evaluation: Versioned text, held-out paraphrase, voice, tool-call, safety, groundedness, latency, interruption, and recovery suites retain run counts and denominators.
methodology.boundary: The employee data and enterprise integrations are simulated. Evaluation establishes prototype behavior, not production deployment or employer-system connectivity.

role: I designed and built the product experience, workflow architecture, evaluation system, and test-driven iteration process.

pageSections.title: Conversation becomes useful when it changes what the employee can see and do
pageSections.description: Relay starts with a familiar employee workspace, then adds a conversational layer that can explain the current state, open the exact object, prepare an action, wait for confirmation, and verify the result.
pageSections.context: Northstar Analytics is the fictional employer and all records are synthetic. Relay is the product and assistant brand.

pageSections.title: The model proposes; the application controls the action
pageSections.description: Read and navigation requests can complete directly. State-changing requests move through a separate review and verification path.

items.title: Discover
items.body: Resolve the signed-in employee and read current scoped records.

items.title: Ground
items.body: Connect the request to a typed record, route, responsible party, and safe next step.

items.title: Prepare
items.body: Inspect the registered capability and render the proposed action in the workspace.

items.title: Confirm
items.body: Wait for the employee to inspect and explicitly confirm the visible proposal.

items.title: Execute and verify
items.body: Run with an idempotency key, re-read state, and only report success when the result is present.

pageSections.title: Conversation, policy, and state stay separate

items.label: Conversation
items.title: Deepgram handles the realtime turn
items.body: Nova-3 speech recognition, agent reasoning and function selection, and Flux speech synthesis provide the voice interaction layer.

items.label: Application
items.title: Relay owns identity and capability policy
items.body: The server resolves employee scope, validates semantic targets, inspects capabilities, and rejects client-supplied authority.

items.label: Evidence
items.title: Final state, not fluent text, decides success
items.body: The evaluator checks the page, focused record, confirmation card, calendar, and server records for every workflow turn.

pageSections.title: What is connected today
pageSections.markdown: Relay's portal, typed records, navigation, confirmation-gated capabilities, in-session workflow state, evaluation runs, and Deepgram conversation layer are implemented. The employer and employee records are fictional. Calendar behavior is a Relay demo surface, and the project does not claim live SAP, Oracle, Outlook, Google Calendar, payroll, or case-management integration.
